Title: Snowshoeing and Onsen Adventures in a Winter Wonderland -Sapporo.
Description:
Experience local knowledge of the trails around Sapporo. Learn how to travel in snow with snowshoes and enjoy the great outdoors.
Unlike skiing and snowboarding, it's an accessible activity for almost everyone and allows for exploration in areas that are inaccessible by other means.
Before the hike commences, you will be provided with some helpful information to assist you with moving in a cold environment such as pacing to conserve energy, observing the route ahead, and evaluating the best route to minimize hazards. Learn about nature and navigation skills in a winter environment, enjoy a hearty meal outside for lunch while experiencing the wilderness at a slower, more intimate pace amidst the quiet beauty of the snow-covered terrain.

Title: Full Day Snowshoeing Adventures with Onsen.
Description:
Trekmate Hokkaido offers many fantastic options for a full-day snowshoeing adventure. One unique route we offer is the exploration of the Hoheikyo dam area below Sapporo Dake. This journey leads you through serene forests blanketed in snow, with various routes catering to different skill levels.

The tours include experienced guides who lead you through breathtaking landscapes, ensuring safety and sharing insights into the local environment. Some routes take you to hidden spots with stunning vistas of Mount Yotei or along ridges offering sweeping views of the surrounding countryside. These treks provide a chance to savor a hearty lunch in the midst of nature before continuing the journey. Keep an eye out for wildlife and unique natural features along the way; this kind of experience often makes for unforgettable memories!

Title: 2 Day Guided Snowshoeing Overnight in Shikotsu-Toya National Park.
Description:
The meeting time is 7;30am at Makomanai subway train Station. 
An example of an overnight snowshoeing trek is as follows-
From there we will travel by private transport approx. half an hour to the trailhead. After completing preparation and discussing safety precautions and the day's forecast weather conditions, we will set out for our overnight accommodation traversing through forest, crossing streams, and gradually gaining elevation for 5 kilometres. This should take around 3 hours before arriving at a camping location or an alpine hut. Once we arrive there we can settle in and prepare for the next day's summit approach as well as explore the surrounding alpine lakes or forest for some wildlife watching. 

The next morning will see us enjoy breakfast and then off to the summit for a 2-hour hike to enjoy the legendary vistas.
Returning to the hut, we can enjoy an early lunch and short rest, or continue through to the transportation and spend the afternoon at a local onsen before returning to Sapporo where we finish the tour.

  A full equipment list will be provided of what will be required for these treks when you book any of these excursions.

Title: Green Season Half Day Hikes in Sapporo and Hokkaido with Onsen
Description:
Hokkaido Backcountry Adventure- Explore unique forests, wildlife, and terrain with an experienced guide.
Embark on a mystical half-day hike in Hokkaido’s backcountry. Follow well maintained trails through emerald forests. Discover amazing vistas, encounter elusive wildlife, and feel the pulse of nature. A journey where silence speaks louder than words.

Title: Full Day Green Season Hiking in Hokkaido.
Description:
With many routes to choose from, here is an example of a reasonably challenging summit approximately 40 minutes from Sapporo.

   Embarking on a day hike to Jozankei Tengu-dake is a journey through the rugged beauty of Hokkaido's natural landscape. This ancient volcano, now a series of weathered rocky summits, offers one of the most thrilling day hikes near Sapporo. 

  Starting from a trailhead at an elevation of 440 meters, hikers can immerse themselves in the serene wilderness, following a path that runs alongside the Kumanosawa creek, with its clear waters and lush greenery. The ascent involves navigating steep sections and stream crossings, where ropes are often provided for assistance. After a challenging climb, adventurers are rewarded with the breathtaking view from the summit at 1145 meters, overlooking the surrounding mountains. The Ainu name for this peak, Kitoushinupuri, translates to 'mountain with abundant wild garlic,' adding a touch of cultural heritage to the experience. The best season for this hike stretches from June to November, allowing hikers to witness the vibrant autumn colors or the lush greenery of summer.

   With a total distance of approximately 9.2 kilometers and a difficulty rating of 7 out of 10, this hike promises an unforgettable adventure for those seeking to explore the heart of Hokkaido.

Title: Two Days/Overnight Green Season Hiking
Description:
Embarking on an overnight trek to Soranuma-dake in the Shikotsu-Toya National Park is a journey into the serene heart of Hokkaido's wilderness. This adventure begins at the trailhead located at the end of a large quarry, just south of Sapporo City, and leads hikers through lush forests to the picturesque Soranuma-dake. The trail is well-defined and signposted, ensuring a safe passage through the natural beauty of the area. 

   Along the way, trekkers can find solace in the two huts by the small lake, with the larger Bankei Sanso hut offering shelter throughout the year. The summit rewards hikers with panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and lakes, making the strenuous climb worthwhile. With the trail free from snow from late May into November, it's an ideal trek for those seeking solitude and a connection with nature.

Title: Full Day Green Season Hiking in Sapporo and Hokkaido with onsen.
Description:
